qualifications_or_emphasis: Trade Receivables — Ageing and Recoverability: As at 31st March 2026, trade receivables of ₹ 79.47 Lakh were outstanding for more than six months. Management has represented that these amounts are fully recoverable and no provision for doubtful debts has been considered necessary.

Default / Delay in Payment of Statutory Dues — TDS: The Company had delayed/defaulted in payment of TDS aggregating to approximately ₹ 11.52 Lakh during FY 2024-25. Similar delays may have continued in FY 2025-26. Duties & Taxes payable as per the TB stands at ₹ 9.28 Lakh.
Advance for Land: The Company has made an Advance for Land amounting to ₹120.00 Lakh appearing as an asset in the Balance Sheet as at 31st March 2026.
Unsecured Loans: The Company has unsecured loans of ₹ 1200.81 Lakh (₹ 166.38 Lakh in Previous Year) a significant increase of approximately ₹ 933 Lakh during the year.

Concentration in Loans & Advances: There were loans which had fallen due during the year that have been renewed or extended or fresh loans granted to settle the dues of existing loans given to the same parties. Company has granted loans or advances in the nature of loans either repayable on demand or without specifying any terms or period of repayment.

Advance for Supply of Material: The Company has received advances for supply of material amounting to ₹ 1,481.66 Lakh recognized as a current liability in the Balance Sheet. As per the information furnished by management, the supply obligations against these advances are to be fulfilled pursuant to long-term contracts.
Company does not have an internal audit system commensurate with the size and nature of its business

In the year under review, the gross foreign direct investment (FDI) flows remained resilient at USD 87.0 billion.
The Company maintains a positive outlook for the future. It also aims to make a mark in market of motion / video photography.
